subject: Housing Action Plan and Zoning Overhaul
overview: The board reviewed demographic data revealing that housing costs have significantly outpaced local wages and received status updates on the city's zoning reforms and affordable housing project pipeline.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes for October 2 and November 6, 2024.

items.title: Declaration of Trust Execution
items.summary: Postponed the signing of the Declaration of Trust until January to allow for in-person notarization of the document.

items.title: Housing Action Plan Data Presentation
items.summary: Roberta Cameron presented demographic research showing that Medford's growth is driven by young adults and that median wages in most local industries are insufficient to afford an apartment without roommates or a second income.

items.title: Stakeholder Engagement Schedule
items.summary: The board finalized plans for upcoming stakeholder focus groups on December 6 and 10 to gather input for the Trust's action plan.

items.title: Zoning and Housing Strategy Updates
items.summary: Aditi Moogoor provided updates on the multi-phase zoning overhaul, including massing incentives for the Mystic Avenue corridor, MBTA Communities compliance, and new state laws allowing accessory dwelling units as-of-right.

items.title: City-Owned Land and Development Pipeline
items.summary: The board reviewed requests for proposals for mixed-use developments on city-owned parcels and noted that nearly 200 affordable units are currently in the development pipeline.

items.title: 2025 Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Approved the 2025 meeting calendar, including a holiday adjustment for January and scheduled recesses for July and August.
